name: fastsaver-api
description: Download media from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Facebook, X, Rutube and Likee links as JSON: an agent skill for integrating FastSaver API, plus its remote MCP server.

api_key.title: FastSaver API key
api_key.description: Your key from https://api.fastsaver.io/auth (shown on the dashboard after sign-in). It is sent as the X-Api-Key header to https://mcp.fastsaver.io/mcp.
